items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I had suggested Eddie Sefranski; he got him.

ctx.x: First, when I came off from the Glen Gray band, Charlie Barnet reorganized in '48 and I was with that new band, and he didn't know who to hire, among other things -- he was groping around for musicians, and I mentioned Stan Kenton's first big band had broken up, and they were well known in all the polls and everything, you know, I had suggested Eddie Sefranski; he got him.
